source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
4. All PWR_GB_HSC1~PWR_GB_HSC10 should get pass result.

original_test_intent: After Project SPEC defines HSC and maps HSC1 through HSC10, verify that every applicable power channel responds plausibly to a causally connected downstream load, matches its power-domain specification, and—if an approved threshold is exercised—produces the defined event/protection response and recovery.
original_method: The row says a GPU sensor requires an OS driver, then calls for module stress and `ipmitool sdr elist`. Items and Criteria instead identify ten HSC-labelled power channels. A GPU workload is valid only if the approved power tree proves it exercises the corresponding HSC domain; that relationship is absent from the Master.
manual_activity: An engineer defines HSC, traces each of the ten channels through the power tree, approves the correct per-domain load rather than assuming GPU stress, validates power/cooling headroom, and retains immediate workload-stop and recovery authority.
required_inputs: Vendor/Project definition of HSC and exact HSC1~HSC10 physical controller or monitor identities
Per-channel upstream rail/feed, downstream device or load, slot/board identity, BMC sensor/SDR record, installed applicability and shared-domain/alias relationships
Decision whether the copied GPU-driver note is applicable to each HSC channel, plus the correct driver/runtime or other non-destructive domain-selective load
Sensor power/current/voltage semantics, units, scaling, update/filtering, idle/load range, tolerance, thresholds, hysteresis and SEL/event identity
Per-domain and combined rail/connector/PSU/cooling headroom, protection/trip expectations, ramp/dwell/abort and no-auto-retry recovery
BMC/SDR/controller/board/device/driver/workload versions, evidence clocks, log retention and engineer owner
safety_requirements: Do not expand HSC by assumption, infer that all ten channels feed GPUs, invent raw IPMI bytes or start load until the power-tree and causal stimulus are approved.
Preserve `ipmitool sdr elist` as the source read checkpoint where supported; a vendor or Redfish alternative is a Project Override and cannot claim the IPMI path was validated.
Use idle and one mapped downstream domain at a time before any combined load to detect swapped channels, shared rails, aliases or an ineffective copied GPU workload.
Do not hot-plug, remove power, force a controller trip, change thresholds, inject over-current or use protection activation as a substitute for a bounded functional load unless separately authorized.

Continuously monitor every applicable HSC reading, rail voltage/current/power, downstream device health, GPU telemetry only where relevant, PSU redundancy/headroom, fans, temperatures, SEL and host/BMC state.

Abort on rail/controller/connector/PSU fault, wrong-domain response, power overshoot, thermal rise, downstream device error, unexpected protection trip, BMC loss or host instability; preserve first evidence and do not reset, power-cycle or auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind each HSC label to immutable controller/rail/downstream-load/sensor identity and capture high-level IPMI plus independent rail/device idle telemetry.

Run only the approved downstream workload for one domain at a time, time-align the target and non-target HSC channels with rail, device, PSU, thermal, fan, SEL and host data, then execute an approved combined phase if headroom allows.
Report per-channel delta, attribution, shared-domain/alias behavior, filtering and tolerance; do not let one GPU or aggregate rail satisfy all ten channels.

Separate ordinary dynamic response from any approved threshold/protection checkpoint, stop through the approved workload path, verify recovery, and do not guess HSC/bytes, hot-plug, trip controllers, alter limits, retry or issue verdicts.
engineer_actions: Approve HSC meaning, ten-channel power-tree mapping, applicability, IPMI output, units/tolerances and any shared-domain equivalence.
Resolve whether the GPU-specific Procedure is correct for each channel or approve the proper downstream stimulus in the Review/Project layer while preserving Master text.
Approve individual/combined power and cooling envelope, protection scope, abort/recovery and issue per-channel plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The placeholder correctly refuses guessed bytes but wrongly presumes raw access is required and cannot resolve the HSC/GPU stimulus mismatch. The Master explicitly names high-level `ipmitool sdr elist`.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Validate each HSC record in high-level IPMI first, then use the approved power-tree-specific downstream workload and synchronized rail/controller/device telemetry. Document any alternative read method and its coverage difference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal PWR_GB_HSC1~PWR_GB_HSC10 target, GPU-driver note, module stress, `ipmitool sdr elist`, script and 5/10-minute estimates remain unchanged as source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT HSC POWER-TREE AND CAUSAL-STIMULUS PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define and map all ten HSC domains, baseline their rails, apply the correct mapped downstream load one domain at a time, correlate sensor/rail/controller events, perform only an approved combined phase, separately account for protection thresholds, then unload and verify controller, rail and device recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/GPU-baseboard power tree, installed controller and downstream-device population, rail/PSU/cooling design, BMC/SDR and device software stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/HSC-controller/BMC/SDR/BIOS, downstream-device firmware, driver/runtime/workload and telemetry versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project schematic and power-tree mapping, controller/sensor register or SDR specification, rail/connector/PSU limits, protection behavior and qualified downstream workload.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative HSC meaning, power-tree causality, per-domain selective load and protection/recovery boundaries while preserving the questionable GPU wording for traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic GPU load is full coverage only for channels proven to feed that GPU/domain; shared or unexercised HSC paths remain partial and cannot be credited to all ten.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Definition, power-tree map, corrected/confirmed stimulus, sensor contract, power envelope and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A controller may feed multiple devices or aggregate a rail; an unsuitable load can show no change, while excessive load may trip protection and remove downstream power.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may confirm GPU load for a mapped subset, select another non-destructive load for other domains, or use a different supported read tool. It must record original versus actual method, equivalence and untested channels; absent positions are N/A, and a subset cannot claim all ten passed.
expected_evidence: Authoritative HSC definition and HSC1~HSC10 controller/rail/feed/downstream-device/sensor/SDR/applicability power-tree matrix
Engineer disposition of the copied GPU-driver Procedure plus the approved causal workload for each domain
BMC/SDR/controller/board/device/driver/workload versions, high-level IPMI output, sensor units/scaling/filtering, thresholds/events and tolerances
Idle and per-domain workload timelines with target/non-target HSC, rail voltage/current/power, downstream-device, PSU redundancy/headroom, thermal/fan/SEL/host evidence
Approved combined-load evidence, shared-domain/alias attribution and separately labelled threshold/protection coverage
workload stop, recovered controller/rail/downstream-device/PSU/thermal/fan/host/BMC state, preserved first fault and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Criteria target ten HSC-labelled power channels, while the Procedure explicitly calls them GPU sensors and requires a GPU driver. Without a Project power-tree mapping, the copied GPU stimulus may not exercise the named targets. The conflict is preserved and must be resolved in the Review/Project layer, not by changing Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ten-channel power-sensor objective is clear, and Project schematic/topology plus an approved per-domain workload can resolve whether GPU stress is applicable. These are supplyable readiness and engineer-confirmation inputs rather than a permanent irreducible block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its no-guessed-byte boundary but restores the source high-level IPMI method and identifies the unresolved HSC/GPU causal path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees HSC must not be inferred but changes permanent BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 and avoids treating raw bytes as mandatory.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Rejects its unapproved hot-swap expansion as fact, upgrades the copied GPU wording to an explicit source conflict, and adds per-domain power-tree, no-hot-plug and shared-rail evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents a copied GPU workload or guessed acronym from being credited to ten power domains and defines how each channel can be causally and safely proven.
independent_technical_reasoning: A power-sensor range named HSC1~10 is testable only after each channel is tied to a physical rail and controllable downstream load. The GPU-driver statement may be correct for some or all channels, but that is a topology fact—not something the AI may assume. Selective domain loading reveals swaps and shared rails; threshold trips remain a distinct, explicitly approved coverage item.
